name: 710 Labs Live Rosin 1st Press | The Rucker #1
description:
First press hash rosin made from a full spectrum of trichome heads. Store in the freezer. Dab between 480 - 530°F.

Genetics: (Gary Payton x Spritzer)

Tasting Notes: A sweet gelato profile with notes of citrus on the backend.
